collection.title: Abarth 124 Spider Convertible 2016 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Abarth 124 Spider Convertible (2016 to 2019) requires windscreen wiper blades to ensure clear visibility in all weather conditions. The driver's side blade should be 18" in length, while the passenger's side blade should be 19". These windscreen wiper blades are specifically designed to fit the Abarth 124 Spider Convertible (2016 to 2019) model, which features a Hook type arm attachment for easy installation. Trust our high-quality windscreen wiper blades to maintain excellent visibility and keep you safe on the road.
